notes.title: Can’t wait to play Mad Age & This Guy?
notes.content:
We’re polishing the game and adding last changes to make [b]Mad Age & This Guy[/b] captivating and interesting for our players. 

Since [b]October 24th[/b] you’ll be able to spend your evenings, weekends and work breaks by saving the world from evil scientists!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525221/8d2e47617d3e853125717e7fc6fbf078815d9dd3.png[/img]


[b] So what would be so thrilling about the game?[/b] 
[list] 
 [*]Pixel art graphics, elements and mechanics from classic games which were renewed to bring you new exciting experience.
 [*]Gameplay full of exciting action and logical puzzles. You will have to solve lots of puzzles to prevent mad scientists from taking over the world.
 [*]3 different worlds with dozens of unexpected traps. You’ll have to wander through dark caves full of danger, shivering glacier and frightening villain’s fortress. And watch out! Steam-powered robots will try to prevent you from getting back the stolen plans.
 [*]Game will be available in 6 different languages – English, Spanish,  Chinese Simplified, Polish, Russian and Ukrainian. French and German languages to come soon! 
 [*]And we'll also prepare Steam Trading Cards for our players! 
[/list] 

[b] Are you excited? We bet you do!
Only one week left until release![/b] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525221/c81a694777212c56ba0ed39938b1100c6a07791d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Mad Age & This Guy presented at PGA
notes.content:
We've back from Poznan Game Arena – huge trade show for games with around 72,000 visitors, more than 220 exhibitors, 10 exhibition halls, hundreds of games, youtubers, investors and journalists from around the world. What an amazing experience it was! 

Of course, we presented our game there!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525221/6d8165e1ef33b231d7b0b34034676a540e453045.jpg[/img]
 
During 3 days hundreds of people visited our booth – groups of friends, families with kids, couples and single players. Everyone had fun playing Mad Age & This Guy!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525221/71d1d0f2498c0fcc7e6938bf22c17c4706f946e2.png[/img]  
     
Thanks to all our players for your valuable feedback! We'll definitely implement your suggestions to make Mad Age & This Guy even better!

notes.title: Mad Age & This Guy on sale on October!
notes.content:
Hi! 
We are [b]Atomic Wolf[/b]! 🐺

[b]Atomic Wolf[/b] is a small indie game development studio based in Poland with an ambitious goal – to create games based on amazing stories and unforgettable characters.

We're preparing for the release of our first game - [b]Mad Age & This Guy[/b], which is a dynamic arcade game that combines many elements from the best classic games you all remember and love.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525221/585f4edeede2beaa6b85e27e60fc54aa5319b8cd.png[/img]

To get players feedback we already did quite a trip! 

In August we were presenting [b]Mad Age & This Guy[/b] at [b]China Joy in Shanghai[/b]. In China, Atomic Wolf team presented demo of the game for the very first time,  and got a lot of positive feedback from the Chinese players.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525221/cf45d3612e31b1ae39917d88068c04b0961ff93f.png[/img]

Right after that, together with 24 gaming studios from Poland, we presented [b]Mad Age & This Guy[/b] at [b]PAX[/b], the biggest gaming fair in USA. At PAX our game once again was in the center of attention of players and media.
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30525221/e2b1ec16b66696e0767815bf245ee3aca7b9016e.png[/img]

[b]What are next steps?[/b]

[b]Mad Age And This Guy[/b] will be available on Steam soon, but you can already [b]add it to your wish list[/b]:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/671650/Mad_Age__This_Guy/  

Besides, if you're visiting [b]Poznan Game Arena[/b], the biggest trade fair for video games held on October 6-8th in Poland, don’t forget to visit [b]Atomic Wolfs’ booth[/b]! We’ll have a lot of swag & pins!

[b]And don’t forget to follow us on Social Media! Click now!
→ [b]Facebook[/b]: https://www.facebook.com/atomicwolfgames/
→ [b]Instagram[/b]: https://www.instagram.com/atomicwolf_games/ 
→ [b]Twitter[/b]: https://twitter.com/AtomicWolfGames 

Stay tuned for more updates! 

Best,
Atomic Wolf
